title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.18375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although automated methods have improved echocardiographic workflows, progress remains constrained by the need for large, well-annotated datasets. As the development of clinical databases is often limited by ethical and logistical challenges, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising alternative. However, existing approaches commonly rely on left ventricle shape-based supervision or are tailored to specific cardiac views, limiting the generation of additional standard and unconventional imaging planes and the preservation of multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences. translated_title: 基于人工智能的动态形状控制多视角超声心动图图像合成
translated_abstract: 尽管自动化方法已经改善了超声心动图的工作流程，但进展仍然受限于对大型、标注完善数据集的需求。由于临床数据库的建立通常受到伦理和后勤方面的挑战限制，合成数据生成已成为一种有前景的替代方案。然而，现有方法通常依赖基于左心室形状的监督，或仅针对特定心脏视图定制，这限制了生成更多标准和非常规成像平面的能力，也无法保持跨心腔的多视角一致性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种新颖的形状控制多视角超声心动图序列合成框架。首先，从动态全心脏网格中提取多视角横截面，然后通过两阶段基于人工智能的流程引入类似超声的外观。在第一阶段，非配对的GAN-扩散模型将这些截面转换为具有超声特征的图像表示，第二阶段进一步提升合成图像的真实感和质量。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于动态全心脏网格形状控制的两阶段AI生成框架，能够合成具有跨心腔多视角一致性的超声心动图序列，突破了现有方法局限于左心室形状监督和特定心脏视角的限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel two-stage AI framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences from dynamic whole-heart meshes, overcoming existing limitations of left ventricle-only shape supervision and view-specific approaches to achieve multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers.
